newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian vehicle sales up 14.9 pct in April.
newsitem.headline: Colombian vehicle sales up 14.9 pct in April.

text.p: Colombia's car and truck sales rose 14.9 percent in April over the same month last year to a total of 11,453 vehicles, according to a closely-watched industry survey.

The survey by GM Colmotores, the local subsidiary of General Motors Corp, said the monthly increase contributed to a 5.6 percent growth in car and truck sales in January-April over the same period a year ago.
Imported models accounted for 2,410 of total vehicle sales in April, the survey said, adding that this was up from import sales of 2,097 in April 1996.
